title: Evaluating the Fairness of Discriminative Foundation Models in Computer Vision

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring Demographic Disparity (DDP) and Disparity in True Positive Rates (DTPR) in zero-shot classification; calculating Skew@k, DDP, and cosine similarity differences with ANOVA statistical tests in image retrieval; conducting qualitative analysis of misgendering and gendered word frequencies in image captioning; and evaluating the accuracy of predicting gender using linear probes on image embeddings.

Measuring Demographic Disparity (DDP) in zero-shot classification; calculating Skew@k, DDP, and absolute differences in average cosine similarity with ANOVA statistical tests across racial groups in image retrieval; and evaluating the accuracy of predicting race using linear probes on image embeddings.

Measuring Disparity in True Positive Rates (DTPR) for age categories (e.g., child vs. adult) in zero-shot classification tasks, and evaluating the predictive accuracy of age attributes using linear probes on image embeddings.
